rationale: Spot verification at reviewed commit 8193ca9757be677ede5fa82b9e0b2507b0e09d36 passed all three new G1 end-to-end tests and the selected G2 zero-side-effect regression. The G1 tests pin the exact default-selection line and displayed-row-1 behavior on both emit-only and claim paths, and pin the positional emit-only readiness/filter bypass. The G2 regression confirms a negative pick preempts positional dispatch on both paths without claiming the bead. The round-2 change is confined to the four disclosed next-selection files. The disclosed rendering judgment is technically appropriate: termsafe.Escape preserves legitimate printable short-form selectors while escaping control content, whereas runEmitOnly's full-ID-only argument is correctly rendered with idrender.Bead. No spec-branch-corrupting defect was found, and the bead worktree remained byte-identical at the reviewed commit after testing.
